title: Legal and regulatory requirements are understood and managed
text: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented.

title: Context is established and understood
text: Intended purpose, context of use, and expectations of the AI system are documented and understood.

title: AI system impact assessment
text: The organization shall assess impacts of the AI system to individuals and society throughout its lifecycle.

title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
text: The organization shall define and document processes for the responsible use of AI systems.

title: Event logging
text: The organization identifies the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.

title: Risk assessment
text: The organization conducts an assessment of risk, including the likelihood and magnitude of harm.
